admission.justification: Executable checks pin each band boundary and the different exit statuses for watchful and over-limit files.

applicability: Line-count classification and hard-rail status for readable Python files measured by the file-size gate.
conditions: With default limits, the inclusive band ceilings are 300, 600, 900 and 1200 lines. Watchful starts at 301 lines.
The CLI defaults to scanning src and tests. With an explicit --hard-limit, the hard rail follows that limit.
exclusions: Tool invocation and source-read errors are outside the size-based exit rule.
statement: The file-size gate classifies Python files into five ordered bands, reports watchful files starting at 301 lines and fails only when a file exceeds the hard limit.
title: Five-band Python file-size gate and hard limit
